title: Lavender Grab Bar, 63-Inch Wall-Mounted 3-Post ADA Compliant Iron Pipe, Pipeline Collection, Allied Brass
description: Grab bar for bathroom safety and accessibility, 63 inches long (63-inch, 63in) with wall mount / wall-mounted installation and a 3-post mounting configuration in Lavender, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat. This ADA compliant bathroom grab bar (safety bar, support bar) is rated for 250 lb capacity and includes a third center bracket for added stability on an extended length bar. Iron pipe construction with an industrial, pipe-style look for industrial bathroom hardware, loft bathroom fixtures, and pipe-style bath accessories; ideal for matching pipeline decor in the Pipeline collection. Durable powder coat finish supports corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Product dimensions: 63 in L x 3 in H x 3.58 in W with 3.58 in projection. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass Pipeline collection.
